verdict.rationale: Visa documents concrete public REST endpoints for the core flows, with published production and test hosts: card enrollment via POST /acp/v1/tokens, purchase intents via POST /acp/v1/instructions (including cancel), and scoped credential retrieval via POST /acp/v1/instructions/{id}/credentials. A self-serve sandbox signup and an official MCP server/agent toolkit back this up, and a live probe confirms the gateway is up and credential-gated as documented. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of calls to the Intelligent Commerce endpoints themselves, and general availability beyond the 'in the process of development and deployment' caveat with contact-Visa production access.
